Keeping your toes healthy is important for overall foot care. Wash your feet daily with mild soap and dry them well, especially between the toes, to prevent moisture buildup. Trim your nails straight across to avoid ingrown toenails. Wear comfortable, breathable shoes that fit properly to prevent pressure and irritation. Moisturize your feet but avoid applying lotion between the toes to reduce the risk of fungal infections. The key to a strong and stable structure lies beneath the surface. Let’s dig into the fascinating world of footings! 🔍 🌐 Footing Fundamentals: Footing is the unsung hero of construction, responsible for transferring the weight of a building to the solid ground below. It’s a game-changer! But how do you choose the right type of footing? 🤔 ✅ Factors to Consider: 1️⃣ Depth of Safe-Bearing Strata 2️⃣ Soil Type & Condition 3️⃣ Superstructure’s Needs 🏠 Isolated Footing: When you’ve got single columns standing solo, isolated footings are your go-to choice. These footings ensure stability, prevent sinking, and keep things safe and sound. 💰 Cost-Effective Choice: Isolated footings are often the budget-friendly option, especially when the ground’s properties remain consistent. Now, let’s talk types of isolated footings: 1️⃣ Pad Footing: Versatile in shape, efficient, but watch out for lateral forces! What’s your preference – circular, rectangular, or square? 2️⃣ Sloped Footing: Less concrete, less reinforcement, and a sleek 45-degree slope. It’s all about maintaining that perfect angle! 📐 3️⃣ Stepped Footing: A classic approach for residential buildings, although it’s become less common in recent years. 🏘️ 4️⃣ Combined Footing: When space is tight, and individual footings won’t cut it, we combine forces! 💪 What’s your experience with footings? Trigger warning!!!❤️ the moment I broke my 5th metatarsal bone! 12 week healing process.  I learned so much.  One lesson being: Maybe I should stop dancing shoeless 😅 & two: Just how big my love for dance really is.. I will dance till my body allows me to— for ever and fucking ever. till I’m literally age 107!!! I never really grasped how much I live for dance, and how much dance needs to live inside of me- until it was taken away from my life for 12 weeks. Dance is medicine. I will say this to every human I meet, time and time again. to anyone going through anything mentally right now— if you have the privilege and health to get out there and dance, DO IT- go move your body, let the music in, even if it’s just for one song. The benefits could literally heal you from the inside out. Music and dance are always the answer. And I’m so happy to have them back in my life. I feel rich 🦋🦋🦋🦋 As for the injury itself and the healing part of the journey… wow. Not to sound morbid, but it was honestly so beautiful feeling my body heal—feeling my bone get stronger and literally rebuild itself. It gave me such a new appreciation for our bodies and how perfectly made they are. The way your body just gets to work and knows exactly what to do is such a beautiful thing. I know it sounds maybe a little too positive for a situation where I literally broke my foot lol, but I feel like I gained so much wisdom from it. I never really related to injuries before, and this opened my eyes to just how miraculous our bodies and the healing process really are. I’m grateful for all of it🤍🤍🤍 #shuffle #5thmetatarsal #shuffledance footwork #cuttingshapes
